prerequisite: complete digest-bound P3 RULER audit; P4 baselines run even if the adaptive causal arm is withheld
optional_context_gate: run only after both policies complete 131072 tokens at batch 1, concurrency 1
matrix_interpretation: batch and serving-concurrency sweeps are separate profiles; their Cartesian product is not treated as a realistic serving configuration
paired_policy_order: alternate resident-first and tiered-first by repetition
measurements: CUDA allocated/reserved/peak bytes and allocator fragmentation
logical/hot/cold cache bytes and pinned host bytes
prefetches, evictions, late misses, useful-transfer ratio
native indexer time from a separate untimed one-token trace
greedy prediction digest equality under identical teacher-forced tokens
OOM, timeout, numerical failure, and unexpected exception records

execution.policy_failure_isolated: if either resident or tiered fails, continue all 30 measured repetitions for the surviving policy and report the cell as partial

claim_boundary: Reference PyTorch evidence only. It is not a fused-kernel, multi-GPU, or production-serving throughput claim.
